title: Treasury
description: How much money the business has and where: the total, split by account type and by branch, and each account with its movements.
info: Money moves with operations: POS sales and payments, drawer withdrawals and deposits, cash count differences and deliveries paid. What does not go through the POS is recorded here by hand (a bank deposit, an expense paid by the bank, a transfer between accounts). An administrator can void or edit any movement: the original stays visible, crossed out with the reason, and no longer counts in any balance. Sales and payments are voided at the POS (so stock and the customer account follow); here they can only move to another account. Account types are managed in Lookup tables → Account types.
empty: No accounts yet. They appear with each branch's first synced sale, or create one with "New account".

editForm.hint: The original movement stays recorded as voided (with the reason) and this one replaces it. Balances recalculate on their own.

reprocess.hint: Missing movements? Sales, payments and drawer movements the POS sent before the treasury existed (or that could not be recorded) are brought in with this button. It can be used any number of times: it never duplicates.

reprocess.done_one: {{count}} movement from earlier operations was added.
reprocess.done_other: {{count}} movements from earlier operations were added.

recurrences.title: Recurring expenses and income
recurrences.description: Fixed expenses (electricity, gas, internet, phone, rent…) and recurring income are recorded automatically on their dates. When the amount changes, edit it: the repetition goes on with the new amount from the next date.
recurrences.formHint: Each date is recorded as an ordinary movement of the account. If a date does not apply (paid apart, say), void that movement: it is not recorded again.
recurrences.amountHint: The new amount applies from the next date; what was recorded stays.
recurrences.scheduleLocked: Dates were already recorded: frequency and first date stay (to change them, pause this one and create another).
recurrences.preview: Next dates: {{dates}}. When a month lacks that day, its last day is used.
recurrences.includePast: Also record the dates since the first date that already passed
recurrences.created: "{{concept}}" created: it is recorded automatically on each date.
recurrences.saved: "{{concept}}" updated: the changes apply from the next date.
recurrences.paused: "{{concept}}" paused: no new dates are recorded.
recurrences.resumed: "{{concept}}" resumed: recorded from today (not the paused dates).
recurrences.empty: No recurring expenses or income yet.
